bug_report:
[12 Regression] analyzer: False positives with calloc()
Analyzer assumen that a pointer allocated by calloc() can be != NULL.


** Code:

#include <stdlib.h>
char **f(void) {
    char **vec = calloc(1, sizeof(char *));
    if (vec)
        for (char **p=vec ; *p ; p++);
    return vec;
}
